# 💫 About Me:
AI/ML Engineer at **Sagility** (Bengaluru) with 2+ years building and shipping **production Generative AI and LLM systems** in the healthcare domain. I work end to end: from document ingestion and RAG pipelines to multi-agent workflows with **LangGraph**, served as scalable **Python and FastAPI** services on **AWS** (Amazon Bedrock, EC2, ECS/ECR).

- 🤖 **Agentic AI:** multi-agent LangGraph systems for healthcare document review, with human-in-the-loop steps, Postgres checkpointing and MCP tool servers
- 📚 **RAG:** a pluggable knowledge retrieval platform with OCR ingestion, pgvector semantic search and self-hosted LLMs on vLLM
- ⚡ **Performance:** cut streaming time-to-first-token from **11s to 0.6s** on an agentic assistant; load tested WebSocket AI chat with Locust
- 🧬 **Background:** M.Tech in Biotechnology and a PG program in Data Science, so I enjoy problems where AI meets science and healthcare
- ✍️ I also write the **AI Atlas Collective** newsletter and teach programming and DSA on the side
- 🏆 2nd place, Sagility internal hackathon

# 📌 Featured Project:
**[Viral Host Prediction with ML](https://github.com/saba-anjum27/virus-host-prediction-ml)**: predicts virus hosts from genome sequences using k-mer tokenization, Word2Vec and TF-IDF features, and CNN / LSTM / BiLSTM models (~82% binary accuracy).
